title: CTA row on an oat band: a centred serif heading, a lede, a row of four nav pills, an ink button and a ghost button, a note
use: The call to action that closes a page, above the footer; pills are filters or entry points.

lede.default: 读文档、跑一次示例回测，或者直接打开监控面板。
